name: [CLAN + MINOTAUR + FREE WEEK] Hyaku Asura
desc:
Hyaku Asura is a Hardcore and Fast-Paced Kengan fighting game, where players train rigorously to grow stronger.
Choose from a variety of martial-arts in the game and prove your skill.

Forge your body. Sharpen your reflexes. Dominate your opponents.
The underground remembers only those who are strong.

Hyaku Asura is mainly inspired by Kengan Ashura, Street Fighter & Lookism, with touches of other fictional series.

★ Game is available on Console and Mobile
★ Premium players receive 10% more Yen, and beds are 10% more efficient.
★ Weekend Bonus earns you 1.5× Yen!!
★ To interact with the community, join the Community Server linked below
★ Auto Macro is free if you claim the daily rewards 7 times.

How to grind:
Start by familiarizing yourself with the landmark locations by pressing P and then heading to the Job Board to complete Jobs, Grind Yen and then buy training equipment to start building your stats from the ground up.
